import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error
import lightgbm as lgb
import math
import os

# Define bounding box for NYC to filter outliers
NYC_BOUNDING_BOX = {"lat": (40.5, 41.0), "lon": (-74.5, -73.5)}


def haversine(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    R = 6371  # Earth's radius in kilometers
    lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2 = map(np.radians, [lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2])
    dlat = lat2 - lat1
    dlon = lon2 - lon1
    a = np.sin(dlat / 2) ** 2 + np.cos(lat1) * np.cos(lat2) * np.sin(dlon / 2) ** 2
    c = 2 * np.arcsin(np.sqrt(a))
    return R * c


def manhattan_distance(lat1, lon1, lat2, lon2):
    return abs(lat2 - lat1) + abs(lon2 - lon1)


# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train_full = pd.read_csv("./input/labels.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Clean training data
print("Cleaning data...")
# Filter by NYC bounding box for pickup and dropoff coordinates
mask = (
    (train_full["pickup_latitude"].between(*NYC_BOUNDING_BOX["lat"]))
    & (train_full["pickup_longitude"].between(*NYC_BOUNDING_BOX["lon"]))
    & (train_full["dropoff_latitude"].between(*NYC_BOUNDING_BOX["lat"]))
    & (train_full["dropoff_longitude"].between(*NYC_BOUNDING_BOX["lon"]))
    & (train_full["fare_amount"] > 0)
    & (train_full["fare_amount"] < 500)
    & (train_full["passenger_count"] >= 0)
    & (train_full["passenger_count"] <= 10)
)

train_clean = train_full[mask].copy()

# Add time features
print("Adding features...")
train_clean["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(train_clean["pickup_datetime"])
train_clean["hour"] = train_clean["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
train_clean["dayofweek"] = train_clean["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
train_clean["month"] = train_clean["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

test["pickup_datetime"] = pd.to_datetime(test["pickup_datetime"])
test["hour"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.hour
test["dayofweek"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.dayofweek
test["month"] = test["pickup_datetime"].dt.month

# Add distance features
for df in [train_clean, test]:
    df["haversine_distance"] = haversine(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )
    df["manhattan_distance"] = manhattan_distance(
        df["pickup_latitude"],
        df["pickup_longitude"],
        df["dropoff_latitude"],
        df["dropoff_longitude"],
    )

# Feature columns
feature_cols = [
    "pickup_latitude",
    "pickup_longitude",
    "dropoff_latitude",
    "dropoff_longitude",
    "passenger_count",
    "hour",
    "dayofweek",
    "month",
    "haversine_distance",
    "manhattan_distance",
]

# Split for validation (stratified by fare bins for better estimation)
train_clean["fare_bin"] = pd.cut(train_clean["fare_amount"], bins=10, labels=False)
train_data, val_data = train_test_split(
    train_clean, test_size=0.1, stratify=train_clean["fare_bin"], random_state=42
)

# Prepare training and validation sets
X_train = train_data[feature_cols]
y_train = train_data["fare_amount"]
X_val = val_data[feature_cols]
y_val = val_data["fare_amount"]

# Train LightGBM model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "regression",
    "metric": "rmse",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
}

train_set = lgb.Dataset(X_train, y_train)
val_set = lgb.Dataset(X_val, y_val, reference=train_set)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_set,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[train_set, val_set],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Validate on hold-out set
val_preds = model.predict(X_val)
rmse = np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_val, val_preds))
print(f"Validation RMSE: {rmse}")

# Predict on test set
X_test = test[feature_cols]
test_preds = model.predict(X_test)

# Create submission file
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["fare_amount"] = test_preds
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
